name: io.github.BSVKey/inference-mcp
description: Pay-per-token Claude & Grok inference, settled in BSV, via the inference.bsvkey.com gateway.

environmentVariables.name: BSVKEY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A funded channel key in the form channelId:channelSecret. Open + fund a channel once at https://inference.bsvkey.com. Optional (can be passed per call).

environmentVariables.name: BSVKEY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway base URL. Defaults to https://inference.bsvkey.com/v1; override to point at a self-hosted deployment.

environmentVariables.name: BSVKEY_WIF
environmentVariables.description: A funded BSV private key (WIF) used by the x402_infer tool to pay per call in BSV (no channel). Signing is local; the key never leaves the process. Optional (can be passed per call).

environmentVariables.name: BSVKEY_FUNDED_SATS
environmentVariables.description: The amount you funded your channel with on-chain. When set, usage receipts are verified against this instead of the broker-signed fundedSats. Optional (can be passed per call as fundedSats).

environmentVariables.name: BSVKEY_RECEIPT_STATE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON file where per-channel receipt continuity (seq + running totals) is persisted, so replays are caught across restarts. Optional; in-memory only if unset.
